cycles.diagnosis: Long from-import star statements were being given optional invisible parentheses, so line splitting made invalid parenthesized star imports; fmt-off import statements were also still having explicit parentheses hidden before unformatted mode took over.

file_inspections.reason: Confirmed the expected behavior for long star imports and neighboring normal import splitting cases.
Confirmed that an import inside a fmt-off block must preserve explicit parentheses exactly.
Located the failing unittest methods and their formatting/equivalence assertions.
Inspected LineGenerator.visit_import_from, unformatted traversal, import line detection, and bracket split logic that owns optional import parentheses.

patch_attempt.patch_summary: Skipped custom import parenthesis normalization when already in UnformattedLines and avoided optional parentheses for from-import star statements.

mistakes.description: The first fmt-off guard checked only the current output line state, but the fmt-off marker can be in the import node prefix before UnformattedLines is active.

cycles.diagnosis: The remaining fmt-off failure happened because visit_import_from mutated parentheses before the leaf-level FormatOff transition was raised from the node prefix.

file_inspections.reason: Compared visit_import_from with normalize_invisible_parens, which already checks generate_comments(node) for FormatOff before mutating parentheses.

patch_attempt.patch_summary: Added a FormatOff prefix guard in visit_import_from before modifying import parentheses, preserving explicit parentheses inside fmt-off blocks.
